comments.content: - `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:167` — Casting `updatedAt` to `date` discards its time and changes the returned database type. Two assets updated at `2026-09-06T09:00Z` and `2026-09-06T18:00Z` produce `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp = "2026-09-06"` instead of the actual latest timestamp, so a mobile client comparing this value cannot detect the second update.

- `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:179` — The shared `deletedAt IS NULL` filter changes the semantics of `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp`. If an album’s newest asset is soft-deleted at `T2` while another asset was updated at `T1`, the response reports `T1`; if its only asset is soft-deleted, it reports `undefined`. The removed query returned the deleted asset’s `updatedAt` in both cases.

- `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:146` — Casting `localDateTime` to `date` truncates both album bounds. Assets captured at `2026-09-06T09:15Z` and `2026-09-06T18:45Z` now yield date-only start/end values rather than those timestamps, breaking consumers of the existing `Date` fields and making same-day bounds indistinguishable.

**1. `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` — startDate/endDate silently changed from full timestamps to UTC-midnight dates (~lines 146 and 156, the `::date` casts on the min/max of `assets.localDateTime`).**

The old query returned `min`/`max(assets.localDateTime)` — exact instants. The new query returns `((localDateTime AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date)`, truncating to midnight UTC. `AlbumAssetCount.startDate/endDate` (interface added field at ~line 15, still typed `Date | null`) feed both album-list and album-get responses, i.e. all clients, not just mobile. Concrete failure: an album with a single photo taken at 2026-09-06 14:37:22 previously returned startDate = endDate = 14:37:22; it now returns `2026-09-06T00:00:00Z`. Any UI that renders the capture span ("Sep 6, 14:37", "last taken at 14:37") now shows midnight, and the JWST-style day-rollover case (photo at Sep 5 23:59 + photo at Sep 6 00:01) previously showed a 2-minute span and now shows a 1-day span. The diff's own comment scopes the date-cast intent to the mobile-only field, yet it was applied to startDate/endDate as collateral.

**2. `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` — `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` is now the last update *day* at UTC midnight, not the last asset-update instant (line 167, `::date` cast on `max((updatedAt AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))`).**

The removed `getLastUpdatedAssetForAlbumId` returned the most recently updated asset's exact `updatedAt`; the replacement returns midnight UTC of the latest update day. Concrete failure for the stated consumer (mobile): an album whose newest asset was updated at 2026-09-06T09:30Z is reported as `2026-09-06T00:00:00Z`. A client doing change detection against a stored last-seen value sees the same day-truncated value again after a later same-day update and concludes "no change", skipping the refresh and missing the new/changed asset; any "updated N hours ago" display is wrong by up to ~24h; and two albums updated at 00:01 and 23:59 the same day tie at midnight, destroying the relative ordering the mobile sort relied on.

**3. `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` — UTC midnight as the day boundary makes album dates timezone-inconsistent with the user's local calendar (lines 145–146 and 155–156).**

`AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` fixes the day boundary at UTC midnight regardless of viewer. Concrete failure: user at UTC+8, album photo taken at local 2026-09-07 00:30 → instant 2026-09-06T16:30Z → day-truncated to 2026-09-06 → the album's dates no longer match the photo's local date, and when the returned midnight-UTC `Date` is formatted in the user's timezone it renders as 08:00 local, so displayed album start/end times are wrong by the user's UTC offset. This applies to the startDate/endDate regression in item 1 as well as to lastModifiedAssetTimestamp.

Severity note: all three are in this one query rewrite in `album.repository.ts`; the `album.service.ts` changes (lines ~68 and ~84) are just plumbing the now-wrong values through.

**Defect 1 — `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:138-144` (startDate) & `145-151` (endDate)**
The query casts `localDateTime` to `::date` after `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'`, stripping the time component. The old query returned full timestamps (`min/max(localDateTime)`). The TypeScript interface `AlbumAssetCount.startDate/endDate` is `Date | null` (includes time). Consumers (mobile app, frontend) expecting millisecond precision for sorting, "today" boundaries, or relative-time display will receive midnight UTC values.
**Failure scenario**: Album has assets at `2024-01-15 08:00:00` and `2024-01-15 20:00:00` local time. Old: `startDate=2024-01-15T08:00:00Z`, `endDate=2024-01-15T20:00:00Z`. New: both become `2024-01-15T00:00:00Z`. Sorting within a day breaks; "last asset today" shows as midnight.

**Defect 2 — `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:152-158` (lastModifiedAssetTimestamp)**
Same `::date` cast on `updatedAt`. The old service code returned `lastModifiedAsset?.updatedAt` (full timestamp). Mobile app uses this for "last modified" display and album sort order.
**Failure scenario**: Two assets updated same day at `10:00` and `14:00`. Old: timestamps differ, correct sort. New: both `::date` → same value, sort order non-deterministic; "modified 4 hours ago" shows as "modified today".

**Defect 3 — `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:138-158` (timezone conversion assumption)**
`AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` assumes `localDateTime`/`updatedAt` are stored as *naive timestamps in local time* and converts to UTC. If the columns are `timestamptz` (PostgreSQL timezone-aware) or already UTC, this double-converts (shifts by offset again), producing wrong dates. The old query had no conversion.
**Failure scenario**: `updatedAt` stored as `timestamptz` `2024-01-15 12:00:00+00`. `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` treats it as naive local → converts to UTC → `2024-01-15 12:00:00+00` becomes `2024-01-15 17:00:00+00` (if server TZ=UTC-5) or similar shift. Date may flip to next/previous day.

**Defect 4 — `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:12` (interface mismatch)**
`lastModifiedAssetTimestamp: Date | null` promises a timestamp, but the query returns `date` (no time). TypeScript won't catch this; runtime consumers get `Date` objects at midnight UTC.
